## Descripción
Oops! I have a typo in my first message so i sent it again! I used RSA twice so this is secure right? [chall.py](https://challenge-files.cylabacademy.net/library/d33371f1a01fd9671ac08d9ce0a486325fd0e8ed66ce83fc97ee9a5a07a64cb9/chall.py) [output.txt](https://challenge-files.cylabacademy.net/library/d33371f1a01fd9671ac08d9ce0a486325fd0e8ed66ce83fc97ee9a5a07a64cb9/output.txt)

Hints

1

How are the two messages related?

2

Franklin Reiter _______ _______ attack.
## Solución
```
Dark23-academy@webshell:~$ curl -s https://challenge-files.cylabacademy.net/library/d33371f1a01fd9671ac08d9ce0a486325fd0e8ed66ce83fc97ee9a5a07a64cb9/chall.py -o chall.py

Dark23-academy@webshell:~$ curl -s https://challenge-files.cylabacademy.net/library/d33371f1a01fd9671ac08d9ce0a486325fd0e8ed66ce83fc97ee9a5a07a64cb9/output.txt -o output.txt

Dark23-academy@webshell:~$ cat chall.py
from Crypto.Util.number import getPrime, inverse, bytes_to_long, long_to_bytes, GCD

Message = bytes_to_long(b"[redacted]")
Message_fixed = bytes_to_long(b"[redacted]")
e = 0x11
p = getPrime(1024)
q = getPrime(1024)
phi = (p-1) * (q-1)
d = inverse(e, phi)
N = p*q

ciphertext = pow(Message, e, N)
ciphertext2 = pow(Message_fixed, e, N)

print(ciphertext, ciphertext2)
print(Message - Message_fixed)
print(N)

Dark23-academy@webshell:~$ echo "---"
---

Dark23-academy@webshell:~$ cat output.txt


-3


academy{m3ssage_w1th_typ0}
```
## Notas Adicionales
Franklin-Reiter Related Message Attack — la diferencia conocida entre los dos mensajes (`-3`), ambos cifrados con el mismo `N` y `e=17`. Vamos a implementar el ataque con GCD de polinomios módulo `N`
